note: SCB-weighted: joint county/age/sex/marital status; municipality by county totals. Names, background, country of birth, education, employment and occupation are sampled from SCB tables (see src/structure.py). Health conditions keep the Socialstyrelsen and Folkhälsomyndigheten age/sex rates, with assumed within-cluster correlation. Household type and all text fields are rule-based placeholders, not LLM generated.
